assessment.title: A recorded measurement
assessment.description: An Assessment stores one kind of measurement from one Assessor. A parse run commonly records how a Selection behaves under PanGloss.

baseline.title: A saved project starting point
baseline.description: A Baseline is a saved, minimal copy of the FieldWorks project used to reproduce later measurements. It represents the project as of FieldWorks' last save.

default-selection.title: The project's usual word list
default-selection.description: The Default Selection is the exact Texts and added words Motif measures when a person does not name another Selection.

drift.title: Evidence no longer matches
drift.description: Drift means the project moved after a Dry Run, so its recorded effects no longer describe what Apply would do.

dry-run.title: A measured change preview
dry-run.description: A Dry Run applies a Proposal to a throwaway project copy and reads back the effects. It leaves the live model unchanged.

overview.title: The latest stored evidence
overview.description: The Overview presents project counts and measurements already recorded by Motif. Reading it does not start a Refresh or Assessment.

preflight.title: The final fit check
preflight.description: Preflight compares pending changes with the live model immediately before Apply. A change whose inputs moved or disappeared no longer fits.

proposal.title: A reviewable set of changes
proposal.description: A Proposal groups related Motif operations so a person can inspect, measure, and apply them as one unit.

text-coverage.title: Share of your text that parses
text-coverage.description: Text Coverage is the share of the Default Selection's words, and of their occurrences in the chosen Texts, that parse. The same share measured over a Corpus is called grammar coverage.

walkthrough.title: A tested window guide
walkthrough.description: A Walkthrough is a script that acts on the real Motif window using fixed data. The script also produces its screenshots and short silent clip.
